scope: Local production-boundary dispatch, prerequisite admission, native Call before/after under SRW lock, concurrent crash writer, and raw collector. No live ownership/recovery proof.

sites.2: ComponentConsumer; reason 1 null owner, 2 invalid/excluded table, 3 null dispatch, 4 Niagara dispatch, 5 read fault
sites.3: PrerequisiteAdmission; reason 1 root unarmed, 2 root wrong thread, 3 root predicate, 4 mesh unarmed, 5 Observe, 6 ReadTask, 7 dequeued task mismatch, 8 protocol rejection
sites.4: QueueScope; reason 1 thread, 2 active native consumer, 3 depth, 4 enter/exit mismatch

root_operands: For site3 reason3, operands0=root check (1..5 indexed component/manager/chara/scene/world; 6..9 class tables; 10..16 links; 17 callback+460; 18 read fault), operands1=expected, operands2=actual.
protocol_operands: For site3 mesh reasons, operands0=third argument, 1=armed, 2=pop, 3=expected edge count, 4=observed edge count, 5=contract equality, 6=admitted stamp, 7=queued stamp, 8=dependencies, 9=event head, 10=flags, 11=enabled, 12=constructed, 13=desired thread, 14=payload thread, 15=queued_on_gt predicate.
limitations: Diagnostic native_tick is last published executor completed tick; UINT64_MAX means unavailable. Epoch may be zero at generic sites without a captured value.
No build or native game retry executed by code agent. Guards and terminal disposition remain unchanged.
File writes are synchronous and flushed; IO failure remains terminal and may leave only bounded raw bytes.
